objective: Replace the shared cache without changing public behavior.

invariants: The cache public interface and return values stay compatible
Existing eviction and expiry semantics remain observable
project.rollback: Restore the previous cache implementation behind the unchanged interface.

notes: Asked the owner whether eviction order is part of the public contract; confirmed yes, so it becomes an invariant.
Pre-mortem: the most plausible failure is the eviction order changing; the continuity test pins the observable eviction sequence so a regression fails the suite.

risk.rationale: The cache is shared by more than one component.

execution.rationale: The implementation and its directly related tests share one local write path.

tasks.outcome: Replace the implementation and its directly related tests.
